paragraphs: At the start of a night shift, review the shift plan and verify routes and signals. During the day shift, assemble and disassemble trains with the switching foreman, throw switches, and give hand signals. Locomotive firers monitor boiler oil pressure and water temperature. Stop operations and report repairs immediately when unusual sounds appear. Before handover, clearly transfer all hazards and records from the shift.
